visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with glasses and her hair tied in a bun appears in a close-up, wearing a black athletic bodysuit. She holds a tall bottle of green smoothie with a straw. The background is a bright indoor living area with a white air conditioner on the wall. (2) The scene shifts to a kitchen where the woman, now in a pink shirt, prepares vegetables like celery. She drinks the smoothie while standing near the counter. The lighting is bright and natural, reflecting off the clean white surfaces. (3) The woman is shown at a gym wearing black sports gear, performing hanging pull-ups on a metal bar and later doing weighted squats with dumbbells. The background features gym lockers, weight racks, and other exercise equipment. (4) In a bedroom setting at a vanity, she wears a light blue headband and a grey top. She demonstrates a skincare routine using a cotton pad and then applies serum from a Dermacept C25 bottle using a dropper, massaging it into her skin. (5) She is seen drinking from a large cream-colored Stanley cup in a mirror selfie. She then moves to the kitchen to cook salmon and broccoli in a frying pan. A grey tabby cat walks across the floor in the background. (6) In a professional studio with large lighting equipment and softboxes, she poses for photos in a variety of outfits including a brown skirt and a black long-sleeve dress. The scenes feature vibrant pink and grey backdrops.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: good morning. (2) [Subtitle]: 歡迎來到我的一日 vlog. [Variety]: 妳看起來根本 00 後. (3) [Variety]: 👸 不像 30。像 18 歲. Boni 超美！看不出來是 1991 的 🫠. (4) [Variety]: (少女感秘技?). (5) [Subtitle]: 最近迷上打各種果昔. 早上我懶得準備早餐的時候. 我就會直接喝果汁. (6) [Subtitle]: 然後去運動. 我一週重訓一次、皮拉提斯一次. (7) [Subtitle]: 再來是很重要的皮膚保養. 我平常保養比較喜歡走簡單快速. 就不喜歡用太多東西. (8) [Subtitle]: 那最近最常用的就是這瓶. [Logo]: Dermacept C25 維他命 C 精華. (9) [Subtitle]: 一瓶就可以完成日常的保養，很方便. (10) [Subtitle]: Dermacept 是來自日本樂敦製藥的. 殿堂級醫美品牌. 終於在台灣上市. (11) [Subtitle]: 那最厲害的就是它是純維他命 C 精華. 而且濃度高達 25%. (12) [Subtitle]: 他們的技術很厲害，不只是濃度高. 連純維他命 C 最難克服的，就是穩定性. 還有滲透力的問題也一起解決了. (13) [Subtitle]: 所以一抹就可以馬上吸收. 也很穩定不容易被氧化. (14) [Subtitle]: 那我自己使用一陣子下來呢. 最有感的就是膚色變得比較均勻. 然後整體亮度有提起來. (15) [Subtitle]: 摸起來更滑順、有彈性. (16) [Subtitle]: 但持續使用一段時間後，那些小小的斑點也有變淡. 整個人像燈泡一樣. (17) [Subtitle]: 這瓶它不只是美白，它還可以幫助改善毛孔. (18) [Slogan]: 五大肌膚功效：改善毛孔粗大、亮白送斑、緊緻彈力、膚色均勻、淡化細紋. (19) [Subtitle]: 還有淡化斑點和細紋. 整體的膚質就更加的細緻、緊緻. (20) [Subtitle]: 而且這瓶其實就是日本現在超紅的. Obagi C25 精華. 不用飛日本台灣就買得到了. (21) [Slogan]: 🤙推薦給你們!. (22) [Subtitle]: 再來就是一定要多喝水. 隨時隨地都在喝. (23) [Subtitle]: 能夠自己煮就多煮. 多吃一些抗氧化抗發炎的東西. (24) [Subtitle]: 最後我覺得心態才是最重要的. 不要自認老了就不去跟進流行. (25) [Subtitle]: 還是要有嘗鮮的心好嗎. 也不要沒事亂自稱，自己是姨或是姐.
